# Fysigo

18+ only. Run your Fysigo coaching practice from Claude: build, assign and review training programs, see clients, log workouts and member-entered intake amounts, and read sleep and recovery data. Installs the Fysigo connector (`https://app.fysigo.com/api/mcp/mcp`) and the fysigo skill. Each person signs in to their own Fysigo account once; Claude never sees more than that person sees in the app. Client tools need the Fysigo Coach package.

## What it does

- Build, change and assign corrective and strength programs for yourself or your clients.
- See who is on what and how each client did this week.
- Log drills, sets and member-entered intake; save the peptide and supplement schedules you enter.
- Record, when you ask, why you started, stopped or changed a protocol (schedules stay unchanged).
- Read sleep and recovery data (Oura sync, sleep ratings).
- Create recipe products, submit bundles for review and read product sales.

## How to connect

1. Install: `/plugin install fysigo --marketplace Fysigo/fysigo-claude-plugin`
2. Claude adds the Fysigo connector (`https://app.fysigo.com/api/mcp/mcp`). Approve it when asked.
3. Sign in to your Fysigo account (OAuth) and allow access on the consent screen.
4. No account yet? Create one at https://app.fysigo.com. The personal plan covers your own programs; the Coach package also covers clients.

## Example prompts

- "Who are my clients, and who is on what program?"
- "Put Maria on a hip mobility program and assign it for this week."
- "How did Anna do this week?"
- "Log my squat set: 5 x 5 at 100 kg."
- "Rate last night's sleep and show my recovery trend."

## Data and permissions

Every call runs as the signed-in person. Fysigo handles personal health data (training, sleep, protocols); it is only returned to you through your own session, and destructive tools ask for confirmation. See the privacy policy below.
